comments.author: SuoDuanDao
comments.story: The Inverse Jim Cramer ETF Has Officially Arrived
comments.why: Humorous video of a fish picking stocks, tracking WSB sentiment
comments.text: I came across a humorous video of someone getting his fish to invest in stocks [VIDEO] He was essentially teaching algo trading, and also tracked wallstreet bets sentiment analysis. He went so far as to pitch his investment strategy to serious tech investors (it was ahead of the nasdaq at the time). His Wallstreet bets tracker had been tanking so he focused on the fish investing fund, but I was waiting for one of the investors to suggest he inverse wallstreet bets and make a lot of money.
